sampler_note: the sampler differs from UniDisc's in order, schedule and guidance
disclosure: In I-GATE the four draws share one position set; in I-RAND4 each draw has its own random set; best-of-4 by chain log-likelihood therefore selects over position sets as well as noise in I-RAND4 and over noise only in I-GATE; the direction of the net bias is not established.
note_rand_worse_than_none: re-infilling clean positions with caption-masked prior samples destroys real caption evidence, so I-RAND4 may be worse than NONE, and the contrast then indexes in part how many clean tokens each set touches (AB.4 item 2, A3b.2 item 4)

token_agreement_with_clean_codes.note: descriptive; share of truly changed tokens (agree_changed) or of re-infilled positions (agree_set) whose code equals the original clean code; not restoration (AB.4 item 5)

s2_y_differs_from_m4.note: S2 recomputes Y(NONE) and Y(M) from its own two caption-only passes; a difference from M4's stored value is a bf16 near-tie, counted

patch.label: S2-patch
patch.sentence: no evidence that the flagged set is better placed than a random one under this sampler
patch.note_v: I-GATE is not better than NONE (95 percent interval not above 0) and the cell is not rejected: there is no claim that repair helps (AB.4 item 2.v)
table_note: In I-GATE the four draws share one position set; in I-RAND4 each draw has its own random set; best-of-4 by chain log-likelihood therefore selects over position sets as well as noise in I-RAND4 and over noise only in I-GATE; the direction of the net bias is not established.

Re-infilling clean positions with caption-masked prior samples destroys real caption evidence, so I-RAND4 may be worse than NONE, and the contrast then indexes in part how many clean tokens each set touches.
Kept draw = highest chain log-likelihood, caption masked (A3.2 item 1 (b)).
may_not_claim: the gate's detection (a flagged set that scores better may simply contain fewer clean, evidence-bearing tokens)
that location does not matter if S2 is inconclusive
a causal clause in the title, abstract, highlights or conclusion (AB.1 item 2)
